scriptItem.label: Load ABC from Clipboard (Unpack + 0.01)
scriptItem.scriptCode:
import os import hou
SCALE = 0.01
def _clean_path(text): if not text: return '' p = text.strip().splitlines()[0].strip().strip('"').strip("'") if p.lower().startswith('file:///'): p = p[8:] return p.replace('\\', '/')
def _load_abc_from_clipboard(): path = _clean_path(hou.ui.getTextFromClipboard())
if not path.lower().endswith('.abc'): hou.ui.displayMessage('Clipboard is not an Alembic path:\n%s' % path, severity=hou.severityType.Error) return if not os.path.isfile(path): hou.ui.displayMessage('File not found:\n%s' % path, severity=hou.severityType.Error) return
name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path))[0] safe = ''.join(c if c.isalnum() or c == '_' else '_' for c in name) if safe and safe[0].isdigit(): safe = '_' + safe
geo = hou.node('/obj').createNode('geo', node_name=safe or 'abc_import')
abc = geo.createNode('alembic', 'alembic_in') abc.parm('fileName').set(path)
unpack = geo.createNode('unpack', 'unpack') unpack.setInput(0, abc)
xform = geo.createNode('xform', 'scale_0_01') xform.setInput(0, unpack) xform.parm('scale').set(SCALE)
out = geo.createNode('null', 'OUT') out.setInput(0, xform) out.setDisplayFlag(True) out.setRenderFlag(True)
geo.layoutChildren() geo.setSelected(True, clear_all_selected=True) print('Loaded: %s (scale %s)' % (path, SCALE))
_load_abc_from_clipboard()
